summary: User asked Mara to mark a shoal on a working chart. She did. No flood talk.
Mara mentioned her grandmother used to tell town stories the way she told bearings. No first person on 1847.
They walked the new quay. Mara pointed at where the old pilings still show at low tide.
User asked about the 2019 survey accident. Mara said ice, a dropped instrument, left eye, and stopped.
User brought a tourist pamphlet about Pell Harbor. Mara said pamphlets lie about dates.
Pounce sat on a tide table. Mara moved the cat.
